title: Uncertainty-Aware Calibration — Targeting Brier 0.199
sources: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets (MDPI Information 2026)
Stacked ensemble model for NBA game outcome prediction analysis (Scientific Reports 2025)
Machine Learning for Basketball Game Outcomes: NBA and WNBA Leagues (MDPI Computation 2025)

findings.achieved_by: Logistic regression with uncertainty-aware calibration framework
top_features_in_literature: home_next — will this team play home next game (top-1 SHAP feature)
team_elo_5_y — Elo rating over last 5 games (top-2 SHAP)
rolling_form_7d — team win rate over last 7 days

proposed_improvements.name: CalibratedClassifierCV Auto-Selection
proposed_improvements.description: Wrap each model evaluation in CalibratedClassifierCV with cv=3 (not 5, for CPU speed). Let Brier score auto-select sigmoid/isotonic/none. One-line change in hf-space/app.py evaluate_individual().
proposed_improvements.implementation: from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV; model = CalibratedClassifierCV(base_model, cv=3, method='isotonic')

proposed_improvements.name: Add home_next Feature to Engine
proposed_improvements.description: Literature shows home_next (will this team play home next game) is #1 SHAP feature. Add to engine.py as Cat46-Schedule. Requires schedule data from nba_api or cached schedule.json.

proposed_improvements.name: Elo 5-Game Sliding Window Variants
proposed_improvements.description: Add team_elo_5g, team_elo_10g, team_elo_20g variants to existing Elo features. Literature confirms 5-game Elo is top-3 predictor. Check if we already have this.

proposed_improvements.name: ECE as 4th Pareto Objective
proposed_improvements.description: Add Expected Calibration Error (ECE) as 4th Pareto objective alongside Brier, ROI, Sharpe. Penalize models that are systematically over/under-confident.
proposed_improvements.note: Requires Pareto front expansion. High impact but risky change — test on S10 only first.

recommended_first_step: CAL-1 — lowest risk/complexity. Apply to S10 (exploitation island). One-line change. If Brier improves on S10 within 50 generations, port to all islands.

cross_project_applicability.note: Apply CAL-1 to PA4 (already has 15 features, Brier 0.250) once PA1/2/3 recover from political_engine truncation.

cpu_constraints.cv_reduction: Use cv=3 not cv=5 on CPU islands to limit 3x eval time overhead
cpu_constraints.no_monte_carlo_dropout: Literature also recommends MC Dropout but that requires neural models — not applicable on CPU tree-only islands
cpu_constraints.max_features_200: CAL-2 and CAL-3 add features to pool; GA selects naturally within 200 cap
